notes.title: Mori Chapter 6 0.19.1 Patch // Better Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hello!  This small patch introduces a few typo and transitional fixes plus some nice quality of life tweaks for controller.

A virtual keyboard now pops up at the Enter Your Name screen

Better controller responsivity inside menus

Twinstick scrolling where there are two viewports- like the credits page.

Cheers! ːsilksongː

notes.title: 0.18.2 Patch / Text Edits
notes.notes: After some feedback, I've gone back in and retooled the sex scene in this chapter to provide more detail and better rhythm.

notes.title: 0.18.1 Patch // Backend Bugs
notes.notes: Hello all!  This is patch 0.18.1 that cleans up some issues I've been having with back end flow and UI/UX.  Previously, ending the latest chapters for each of our main characters was sending players occasionally to a black screen or to the main menu.  Script flow has been fixed to now bring players to the credits screen once the story has finished. ːtabbycatː

notes.title: TCM 0.16.1 Patch // Mori's Ch2 CG
notes.notes: This patch updates the images for Mori's Chapter 2 CG (I've Seen Better Days).  The artist noticed some lighting layers were not displaying correctly so adjustments were made.  You do NOT need to replay the chapter to get the updated image, the image should update automatically.  Be aware, the changes are pretty subtle and you may not notice :)

notes.title: 0.7.1 Minor Bugfix
notes.notes:
Moved achievement trigger for this chapter out of the sex scene decision tree.


After some really good feedback from a couple of you, I decided to move the trigger for Mori's ch2 achievement.  It will now be granted to you after laying around on the couch with him to better sync up the flavor text with reward.
